SMTO-AUT-0029 — Your Google account hasn't allowed SMTO to do this

GUID: 31d4c4ef-f57f-5329-b99e-b8b8c173ba96
Slug: google-scope-missing
Domain: AUT · Subsystem: google-workspace

What happened

  • The connected Google account doesn't give SMTO the access this request needs. This older message doesn't say exactly which access is missing.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO what access your connected Google account currently has. This message doesn't name the missing permission, so comparing the account's access with your request shows what's lacking.
  2. Ask SMTO to add just the access this request needs, for example reading Calendar events, to the same Google account under the same name. Adding only what's needed keeps SMTO from getting broader access to your Google data than the task requires.
  3. Open the Google link SMTO gives you, sign in with the same email address, and approve the new access. SMTO can use the new access only after you approve it for that same account.

What success looks like

  • SMTO reports that the account has the access you need, and your request runs without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't connect a different Google account or approve access to everything just to get past this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Legacy compatibility alias google.scope_missing: the saved Google grant lacked access an operation required; current feature checks report google.scope_upgrade_required with the missing features instead.

What this means

  • The retained Google scope-missing alias has no direct current producer; current feature checks report scope_upgrade_required with the missing feature set. No direct current producer was found for this compatibility identity. It preserves historical meaning without inventing missing cause, scope or execution facts.

Why this can happen

  • The retained Google scope-missing alias has no direct current producer; current feature checks report scope_upgrade_required with the missing feature set.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the operation's actual required features with current provider-granted scopes; request only the missing necessary access.

How to fix it

  • This identity has no current producer; current code raises google.scope_upgrade_required with missing_features. Compare the operation's required features with the account's granted scopes (auth.google_status), then reconnect the same account_key through auth.google_connect requesting only the missing features.
  • Reconnect the same account key with only the features needed for this operation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm account identity and required features before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended account satisfies current feature checks without expanding unrelated scopes.

What not to do

  • Do not expose client secrets, tokens, codes or PKCE verifiers.
  • Do not switch accounts or repeat uncertain mutations automatically.
